title: Cryptocurrency & Blockchain Privacy Request Letter Template
metaDescription: Professional template for requesting cryptocurrency privacy data from exchanges, wallets, and blockchain services. Protect your crypto privacy rights.
description: A comprehensive letter template for requesting privacy information and data deletion from cryptocurrency exchanges, wallet providers, and blockchain services. Helps protect your financial privacy and exercise your data rights in the crypto space.

sections.heading: Header and Contact Information
sections.content:

[Company Address]
[City, State, ZIP Code]

sections.heading: Subject and Purpose Statement
sections.content:
Subject: Privacy Rights Request - Data Access and Deletion Request

Dear Privacy Team,

I am writing to exercise my privacy rights regarding the personal data and cryptocurrency transaction information you have collected and processed about me. As a user of your [SERVICE_TYPE] services, I am requesting transparency about my data and seeking to protect my financial privacy.

sections.heading: Account Identification
sections.content:
Account Details:
- Username/Account ID: [USERNAME]
- Email associated with account: [EMAIL]
- Registration date (approximate): [DATE]
- Last login date (approximate): [DATE]
- Verification level: [KYC_LEVEL]

I can provide additional verification information if required to process this request.

sections.heading: Data Access Request
sections.content:
I hereby request access to all personal data you have collected, processed, or stored about me, including but not limited to:

• Personal identification information (KYC/AML data)
• Transaction history and blockchain addresses linked to my account
• Trading patterns and behavioral analytics
• IP addresses and device information
• Communication records and support tickets
• Data shared with third parties, including blockchain analysis companies
• Any profiling or risk scoring data

Please provide this information in a structured, commonly used, and machine-readable format.

sections.heading: Data Deletion Request
sections.content:
Additionally, I request the deletion of the following data categories:

• [DATA_CATEGORY_1] - Reason: [REASON_1]
• [DATA_CATEGORY_2] - Reason: [REASON_2]
• All data shared with blockchain analysis or surveillance companies
• Marketing and behavioral profiling data not required for regulatory compliance

I understand that certain data may need to be retained for legal or regulatory compliance purposes. Please specify what data will be retained and the legal basis for such retention.

sections.heading: Privacy Protection Measures
sections.content:
To protect my ongoing privacy, I also request:

1. Confirmation that my data will not be shared with blockchain analysis companies going forward
2. Implementation of enhanced privacy measures for my account
3. Opt-out from all data sharing arrangements not required by law
4. Regular deletion of unnecessary logs and metadata

I am committed to maintaining my cryptocurrency privacy and would appreciate your cooperation in implementing these measures.

sections.heading: Legal Basis and Timeline
sections.content:
This request is made under applicable privacy laws including [PRIVACY_LAW] and your published privacy policy. I expect a response within [TIMEFRAME] days as required by law.

If you cannot comply with this request, please provide a detailed explanation of the legal basis for refusal and information about my right to appeal or file a complaint with relevant authorities.

Thank you for your prompt attention to this matter. I look forward to your response and to working together to protect my cryptocurrency privacy.

Sincerely,
[Your Signature]
[Your Printed Name]

useCases: Requesting transaction data from cryptocurrency exchanges
Seeking deletion of personal data from wallet providers
Obtaining information about blockchain analysis partnerships
Exercising GDPR or CCPA rights with crypto companies
Protecting privacy after account closure or service termination
